name: Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals, Inc.

name: Hims & Hers Health, Inc.
why: A disappointing quarterly report, reduced profit outlook, sharply narrower margins and a sequential subscriber decline drove HIMSs selloff. Traders are split between concerns about profitability and subscriber momentum and hopes that Peptides+, international growth and the Lilly partnership can support a recovery.

name: Trade Desk Inc
why: Trade Desks quarterly earnings beat and stronger-than-expected outlook sparked a sharp rally, but shares then gave back much of the move as traders focused on flat-to-lower sales, margin pressure, and a revenue contribution that management said would not recur. The community is split between seeing a turnaround and potential short squeeze, and viewing the reaction as a sell-the-news move amid doubts about sustained growth, management, and the buyback.

name: D-Wave Quantum Inc
why: D-Waves Q3 earnings are driving discussion, with traders weighing revenue growth and a narrower loss against weaker quarterly bookings and calls for clearer system-delivery timelines. Reactions are split between those who see improving commercial momentum and cash reserves, and skeptics focused on valuation, losses, and the stocks sharp volatility.

name: Sea Ltd - ADR
why: Seas quarterly results are driving attention: strong revenue growth was offset by an adjusted EBITDA miss and concerns about rising credit losses and growth spending, prompting a selloff. Bulls argue the results were solid and view the decline as an overreaction, while bearish traders remain focused on margin pressure.

name: WhiteFiber, Inc.
why: WhiteFibers NC-1 reaching full operation across its contracted capacity and securing project financing are driving hopes for a revenue ramp, alongside chatter about new cloud business. Skeptics counter that recent losses, cash burn and dilution leave the companys funding outlook uncertain.

name: Digital Turbine Inc
why: Digital Turbines quarterly results sparked debate: revenue beat expectations and the company raised its sales outlook, but margin compression and unchanged profit guidance weighed on sentiment. Some traders view the selloff as excessive given the growth, while others remain concerned about profitability and debt.

name: Venture Global Inc
why: Venture Globals move to expand power generation for AI data centers is driving attention, with traders weighing the potential to monetize its LNG sites against concerns about capital spending, debt and the lack of announced data-center customers. The community is split on whether the initiative complements its LNG business or distracts from it, and some see the stocks decline as a negative reaction to the expansion plans.

name: Bitdeer Technologies Holding Co
why: Bitdeers quarterly results are driving attention, with traders weighing strong revenue growth and bitcoin production against a reported loss and an EPS miss. The reaction is split between optimism about its mining and AI data-center growth and concerns about profitability, cash needs, and potential dilution.

name: Securitize Corp.
why: Securitizes Q3 update, planned River One acquisition to expand into asset-backed lending, and share-repurchase authorization are driving discussion. Traders largely welcome the expansion and buyback, while some question the undisclosed deal terms and remain cautious after earlier earnings and guidance disappointments.

name: Ripple
why: XRP is drawing attention as it sells off alongside a broader crypto downturn, with traders focused on weakening support and whether the decline will deepen. The community is split between dip buyers expecting a rebound and bearish holders citing stalled regulatory progress, doubts about XRPs utility, and concerns over Ripples token supply.

name: Netlist Inc
why: Netlist is drawing attention ahead of its Q3 earnings call, with traders expecting licensing revenue from Samsung and Micron to strengthen results and hoping for updates on SK hynix and a possible Nasdaq relisting. Sentiment is mostly bullish, though some traders caution that expectations are high and the market reaction could disappoint without clear forward guidance.

name: Aragon
